_comment: Each Judicial Council form prints who completes it. DV-100 is the request and the filer completes all of it. DV-109 and DV-110 say the filer completes only items 1-2 and 1-3; the rest is the court's, and those fields are marked courtUse in the field configs so no question is ever generated for them. DV-100, DV-109 and DV-110 are always filed together, so those connectors are unconditional. DV-101 and DV-105 are attachments: the form itself says when to attach it, and the connector asks the same question the form does. DV-101 hangs off item 3's 'Do you need more space to describe the abuse?', and DV-105 off the 'Child custody and visitation' box in the list of orders requested - so a filer who wants neither never sees either interview.
